inventory_note: Seven installed cores retained as requested; SAD is optional and unused by these workloads. GPT uses Norm, Softmax and GPT-vector services; other installed cores are not all active.
topology: Seven local ASIC cores in a shared 128 KiB SPM cluster with one upstream ASIC command endpoint; GEMM is the other endpoint. This is not seven separately routed AutoLink endpoints.

area_model.equation: new cluster = old endpoint - five old units + seven new cores + (7/5 - 1)*(old shared memory peripheral + local controller + endpoint shell)

latency_model.equation: All old ASIC mode cycles multiply by P1 1-CGRA resident segment cycles / old small-case CGRA chain cycles; graph applies P1 1-CGRA graph/resident-segment ratio.

assumptions: Old operator and local-chain modes are proxies, not measurements of specialized task/segment hardware.
A single proportional workload scaling factor preserves old relative ASIC mode costs; attention, memory and control scaling can differ in reality.
New seven-core schedules, shared-SPM arbitration and buffering add no unmodeled latency relative to the old proxy.
Shared control/peripheral area grows linearly from five to seven cores; SRAM payload remains 128 KiB. No redesigned cluster synthesis exists.
All seven ASIC cores keep their measured native/local/configuration area; old unit areas are removed to avoid double counting.
Existing P1 GEMM and shared-control costs are reused; new ownership/refill logic and achieved common clock are unverified.
CGRA values use the conservative minimum AE endpoint already selected for the main figure. The prior 75% refill-overlap scenario is archived separately and is not used in this table.
